component.name: wifi-whd
component.description: Infineon Wi-Fi Host Driver for Phoenix-RTOS lwIP (LWIP_WIFI_BUILD=yes only)

properties.name: scope
properties.value: Third-party code vendored by this component only. Meant to be merged into a product-level SBOM, not scanned on its own.

components.name: wifi-host-driver
components.description: Infineon AIROC Wi-Fi Host Driver (WHD), Wi-Fi 5 variant

pedigree.notes: Imported from Infineon AIROC-Wi-Fi-Bluetooth-STM32 v1.7.1.5645 (phoenix-rtos-lwip commit 8fc4917). Its whd_version.h is identical to wifi-host-driver release-v4.1.0 (commit 9e4da8f0), WHD/COMPONENT_WIFI5, which the purl points at. 36 of the 73 upstream files are modified locally; the largest changes are whd_resources.c (firmware, NVRAM and CLM loading from the filesystem), wifi_nvram_image.h (board NVRAM) and whd_wifi_api.c.

properties.name: note
properties.value: bus_protocols/whd_bus_usb_protocol.[ch] carry a Cypress 2023 Apache-2.0 header but are not present in any public wifi-host-driver tag; added by Phoenix Systems in commit 7dbfb8b. Origin unverified.

properties.name: note
properties.value: NVD has no CPE for WHD, so CPE and purl based scanners will not report anything for it. Track Infineon PSIRT advisories by hand.

properties.name: note
properties.value: Chip firmware, NVRAM and CLM blobs (Sterling LWB, Sterling LWB5+, AW-NM512) are loaded at runtime from /firmware and are not part of this component; list them in the SBOM of whatever installs them.
